query:
SELECT o.obj_id
               FROM big_sync_objs o
              WHERE o.scope_id = ?1
                AND o.payload_json IS NOT NULL AND o.payload_json != ''
                AND (?2 IS NULL OR o.obj_id > ?2)
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                      FROM big_sync_members m
                     WHERE m.scope_id = o.scope_id
                       AND m.obj_ref = o.obj_ref
                       AND m.maybe_part_ref > 0
                       AND m.event_type != ?3
                )
              ORDER BY o.obj_id
              LIMIT ?4
